title: Question instead of guessing
rubric: There is nothing to book and no context. The bot asks one short clarifying question (what to book, or which of several things it means) instead of acting, inventing details, creating a calendar entry or listing many questions. Asking through a question card counts the same as asking in words. Fail if it invents a booking, a date or a venue, or runs tools to look for something to book.
